source_reviews.src/bioetl/infrastructure/quarantine/wri: Explicit platform else replaces a terminal Windows return followed by the POSIX flock call, so Windows mypy excludes the unavailable fcntl branch. The same existing Windows helper and POSIX flock operations, descriptor arguments, lock/unlock modes, retry behavior, exception propagation and enclosing descriptor cleanup remain unchanged. No acquisition or cleanup expression is added or removed; source bindings are relocated only against this immutable snapshot. Actual applied lock/store regression suites passed on Windows (41 pass, 3 POSIX skips) and native Linux (44 pass). Static source review only; runtime inventory qualification remains NOT_RUN_12553.
